_comment: A type with 'needs_name': true is kept only when its name or a title word is in the recipe's title or chapter (every doughnut and salad dressing says so; the model gave 'dressing' to whipped creams, glazes and ganache). Only 'about' is shown to the model: changing one type's 'about' asks again only that type's recipes; the other fields are applied after and ask nothing again. The dish types a recipe can be labeled with (match_utils/dish_labels.py). The chat model picks a recipe's types from this list only, once, when the recipe index is built; anything else it says is dropped. When the model gives no type (or can't be reached), a title whose last word (before any 'with ...' tail) is one of a type's 'title_words' gets that type: 'Chewy Sugar Cookies' is a cookie, 'Pumpkin Bread Pudding' a pudding (not a bread). 'about' is what the model is told the type covers. Editing this file relabels every recipe on the next index build. Lowercase, singular. A type's 'implies' are added whenever it's given: a chicken dish is a meat dish too. A type's 'keywords' are specific foods that mean the type wherever they are in a title, added to what the model says: 'crepe' is a pancake, 'bulgur' rice and grains, 'salmon' seafood. Keep them to words that can't mislead ('rice' would make Rice Pudding a grain dish).

cookie.about: cookies of any kind: drop, rolled, sandwich, shortbread, biscotti, macaroons, meringue cookies

bar.about: bar cookies baked in a pan and cut: brownies, blondies, lemon bars

cake.about: cakes: layer, sheet, bundt, pound, loaf cakes, cupcakes, roulades, upside-down cakes, coffee cake, shortcake (not cheesecake, which is its own type)

cheesecake.about: cheesecakes of any kind, baked or no-bake, and cheesecake bars (a cheesecake is neither a cake nor a custard)

pie.about: pies, sweet or savory, including hand pies and pot pies

fruit dessert.about: baked fruit desserts with a topping: crisps, crumbles, cobblers, buckles, slumps, pandowdies

pudding.about: puddings, custards, flans, panna cotta, pots de creme, mousse, souffles, bread pudding

ice cream.about: ice creams, gelato, frozen yogurt, sorbets, sherbets and semifreddos (ice cream sandwiches, cakes and pies are frozen desserts)

frozen dessert.about: frozen desserts made with or around ice cream or ice: ice cream sandwiches, ice cream cakes and pies, bombes, sundaes, popsicles, granitas

candy.about: candy and confections: brittle, toffee, fudge, caramels, truffles, marshmallows, bark, candied nuts

frosting.about: sweet frostings, icings and glazes for cakes, cookies and pastries, buttercream, ganache. A glaze for meat or fish is a sauce, and a cake with frosting is a cake

filling.about: fillings for desserts: curds, pastry cream, whipped cream, compotes, pie and cake fillings (not jams, which are their own type)

jam.about: jams, jellies, preserves, marmalades and fruit butters, sweet or savory (herb jam, tomato jam)

dessert sauce.about: sweet sauces poured over or served with desserts: caramel, chocolate, fudge, butterscotch, fruit sauces, dessert syrups (not savory sauces)

pastry.about: pastries and filled baked doughs: croissants, danishes, kolaches, knishes, rugelach, puff pastry, choux, eclairs, cream puffs, strudel, turnovers (doughnuts are their own type)

doughnut.about: ONLY doughnuts: yeast or cake doughnuts, doughnut holes, crullers, beignets. Croissants, kolaches, knishes, rugelach, buns and other yeast doughs are pastries or breads, not doughnuts

crust.about: pie and tart crusts and doughs, crumb crusts, pastry doughs made to hold something else

bread.about: yeast breads: loaves, rolls, cinnamon rolls, buns, focaccia, flatbreads, bagels, pretzels, brioche, sourdough

quick bread.about: breads leavened without yeast: banana bread, zucchini bread, cornbread, soda bread

biscuit.about: flaky American biscuits made with baking powder (not yeast rolls, not doughnuts)

pancake.about: pancakes, crepes, blintzes, dutch babies, flapjacks

breakfast.about: breakfast dishes: granola, oatmeal, porridge, french toast, breakfast casseroles

cracker.about: crackers, crisps and savory snacks baked to be crunchy

snack.about: snacks to eat out of hand between meals: popcorn, chips, roasted nuts and chickpeas, snack mixes, energy bites

soup.about: soups, chowders, bisques, broths served as soup

stock.about: stocks and broths made to cook with

dressing.about: ONLY a dressing made to toss with or pour over a salad: vinaigrettes, creamy salad dressings like ranch or caesar. Never give it to a dish just because it has a dressing or a sauce on it (an egg salad is a salad, crepes suzette are pancakes); mayonnaise, pesto, gravy, pasta sauces and dips are not dressings

sauce.about: savory sauces spooned over or served with a dish: tomato and pasta sauces, gravy, jus and au jus, pan sauces, glazes for meat or fish, pesto, aioli, hollandaise, chimichurri, dipping sauces (salsas are their own type)

salsa.about: salsas of any kind: tomato, tomatillo, fruit and herb salsas, pico de gallo, salsa verde (a salsa is a dip too)

condiment.about: things kept on hand and added at the table or to a sandwich: mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard, hot sauce, relishes, chutneys, pickles, flavored butters and oils, savory spreads (spice mixes are their own type)

spice mix.about: spices and spice mixtures: chili powder, curry powder, garam masala, za'atar, dry rubs, seasoning blends

dip.about: dips: hummus, guacamole, bean dips, cheese dips

pasta.about: pasta and noodle dishes, fresh pasta, dumplings like gnocchi

rice and grains.about: rice and grain dishes: risotto, pilaf, fried rice, polenta, couscous, quinoa

egg dish.about: dishes built on eggs: omelets, frittatas, quiche, scrambles, shakshuka, deviled eggs

sandwich.about: sandwiches, subs, hoagies, wraps, burritos, quesadillas, panini (burgers and tacos are their own types)

burger.about: burgers of any kind: beef, turkey, salmon, bean or vegetable burgers, sliders

dumpling.about: dumplings: potstickers, wontons, pierogi, gnocchi-like and soup dumplings (empanadas, spring rolls and samosas are their own types)

empanada.about: empanadas and other hand pies with a savory filling

spring roll.about: spring rolls, egg rolls and summer rolls

chicken.about: dishes built on chicken or other poultry like duck (turkey is its own type)

beef.about: dishes built on beef: steaks, roasts, ground beef, short ribs, brisket

pork.about: dishes built on pork: chops, roasts, bacon, ham, sausage, carnitas

meat.about: any dish built on meat: beef, pork, lamb, poultry, game, sausage, meatballs; give the kind of meat too (beef, pork, lamb, chicken, turkey)

vegetarian main.about: meatless main dishes built on tofu, tempeh, seitan, beans or vegetables

vegetable side.about: side dishes built on vegetables other than potatoes: roasted, sauteed, steamed, grilled or braised vegetables (potatoes are their own type)

potato.about: dishes built on potatoes or sweet potatoes: fries, mashed, roasted or baked potatoes, potato gratins, hash browns, latkes, potato salad (potatoes play a different part in a meal from other vegetables)

fried food.about: foods deep-fried or pan-fried in oil: fritters, tempura, croquettes, hush puppies, onion rings, fried chicken, falafel (a fried dish can have its other types too)

beans.about: dishes built on beans, lentils or chickpeas

drink.about: drinks: lemonade, cocktails, smoothies, hot chocolate
